question:
The National population register was created under the provision of _________ and

a) Citizen Act 1965

b) Citizenship Rules 2004

c) Citizenship Act 1955

d) Citizenship Rules 2003
solution:
The correct answer is __**1)c-d**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Population Register (NPR) is linked to the **Citizenship Act 1955**.
 
• The NPR is governed by the rules laid out in the **Citizenship Rules 2003**.
 
• The NPR aims to create a comprehensive identity database of every usual resident in the country.
 
• It includes both demographic and biometric details of the individuals.
 
• The NPR is prepared at the local (village/sub-town), sub-district, district, state, and national level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Citizenship Act 1955**:

 
 
• This Act provides the provisions for the acquisition and determination of Indian citizenship.
 
• It has been amended several times to address various aspects of citizenship.
 
 
 
• **Citizenship Rules 2003**:
 
 
• The rules were framed to facilitate the implementation of the Citizenship Act 1955.
 
• They include provisions for the registration of citizens and the issuance of national identity cards.
 
 
 
• **National Population Register (NPR)**:
 
 
• The NPR is a comprehensive database of all usual residents in India.
 
• It is mandatory for every usual resident to register in the NPR.
 
 
 
• **Demographic and Biometric Data**:
 
 
• Demographic data includes details like name, date of birth, gender, and marital status.
 
• Biometric data includes fingerprints and iris scans.
